summary: Phase 4 Admissions -> Students -> Enrollment backend tested end-to-end via pytest. 41/41 tests passed covering: public admission intake incl. validation & duplicate protection, review workflow with all transitions and 409 wrong-state errors, atomic enroll flow (student+user+enrollment creation, temp password login, dedup-by-email reusing same student), format checks for KWI/ADM, KWI/REG, KWI/26/CMS/#### numbers, session_id-required-at-enroll-time, /me/* self-service RBAC & 403 for un-linked account, cross-student staff endpoint blocking for student role, document upload (PNG success, TXT rejected, invalid doc_type 422, CSRF required, random server-generated filename verified on disk), staff student/enrollment CRUD & search, CSRF enforcement, audit_logs for all expected actions (incl. admission_submitted with user_id NULL), and Phase 2/3 regression smoke.
critical_code_review_comments: AdmissionController.enroll: PDOException handler catches 23000 and responds 'already enrolled' but the enrollments table's unique constraint on (student_id, course_id, session_id) is not verified in tests — main agent may want to add an explicit dedup test for enrolling the same student for same course+session twice. Test-wise not currently reachable via re-enroll since admission flips to 'enrolled' and cannot be re-enrolled from that state.

AdmissionController.store validates 'email' only for max length; a syntactically invalid email (e.g. 'notanemail') is silently accepted. Consider adding an email() validator for consistency with production data hygiene.

AdmissionController.enroll builds the student's users row using the applicant email — if there is ALREADY a users row with that email but no student_id (e.g. reused address of a staff account), the INSERT would fail with a unique constraint 500. Not currently protected against; low-probability but worth guarding.

StudentController.index search uses uniquely-suffixed placeholders bound to the same value (:search1/:search2/:search3) — correct workaround for ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false. Same pattern applied in AdmissionController duplicate-check (:sid1/:sid2). No other placeholder-reuse instances found on grep.

Response::json is called from within controllers (not returned) via exit-inside-Response; works fine but keeps state coupled — consider throwing exceptions instead for cleaner controller code (non-blocking).
test_credentials: Canonical accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md used unchanged. Alice Wonder (student_id=3, alice.wonder@example.com / Iwt5CBibo5Xs) fixture intact. All TEST_*@example.com throwaway rows cleaned up by module-level teardown.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent fixtures created. Throwaway admissions/students/users/enrollments/documents (email prefix 'TEST_') created and cleaned up in-place by the pytest module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 is fully green. Fixture data preserved: institution 11 (KWI-MAIN), course 16 (CMS) linked, sessions 4 (Autumn 2026 active) and 5 (Spring 2027 upcoming). Alice Wonder student id=3 has 2+ enrollments now (rolls KWI/26/CMS/0001, /0002 plus one more from the successful enroll test — the dedup test increases counts too but only for TEST_ emails which get cleaned up). Reg counter is at KWI/REG/2026/000001 + N used numbers; ROLL counter KWI/26/CMS/#### advanced further from tests. Run Phase 5 exams against course 16 + student 3. Regression suites: tests/test_auth_phase2.py, test_academics_phase3.py, test_admissions_phase4.py — all pytest-based.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this phase. Main agent's pre-emptive fix for the SQLSTATE[HY093] placeholder-reuse pattern (in AdmissionController duplicate-check and StudentController search) is verified working — both endpoints exercised extensively without any 500s.
